capabilities: Search Douban and create notes for movies, TV shows, books, music, games, diaries and people
Sync personal watched/read/listened/played records with ratings, states, comments and collection dates
Download cover images to local attachments or an image host
Customize import templates and note save paths
extras: README is mainly in Chinese. Planned but unchecked features include AI analysis via ChatGPT, Deepseek or Ollama. Personal data (myTags, myRating, myState, myComment, myCollectionDate) requires logging into a Douban account in the plugin. The disclaimer recommends backing up data before use and notes only technical/study use; syncing with 'replace same-name documents' enabled can overwrite existing notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull media metadata or a user's watched/read/played records from Douban into notes.
